Planning to buy a smartphone during the Flipkart Big Diwali or Amazon Great Indian Festival (GIF) sales, but feeling confused by the sheer number of options? Don’t worry at all! We’ve curated a list of the best smartphones across various price points—ranging from ₹15,000, ₹20,000, ₹25,000, ₹30,000, ₹35,000, and ₹40,000, all the way up to ₹1 lakh. Just take a look at our list; it will make your decision much easier. Have a fantastic Diwali!
